title: codeLens/resolve
description: Forwarded LSP 3.17 request, typed in eludite-protocol (lsp::ResolveCodeLens, brief 0052). Params are a CodeLens as received from textDocument/codeLens (code-lens.json $defs.codeLens, data unchanged) plus eluditeGeneration; the result is the lens with its command. The pinned Roslyn resolves a references lens to the title "N references" and the command roslyn.client.peekReferences, which the host maps to eludite.editor.find_references (code-lens.json $defs.referencesArguments). A lens resolved for an older syntax version of its document is ContentModified (-32801). The host validates that params.range is an object.
